title: Syngas-derived hydrophilic nanocarbons for water purification
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,24370-24377
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00312E, Paper

Boborahimov Azamat Boborahim Ugli, Takeshi Fujita, Shusaku Shoji, Kako Tetsuya, Hideki Abe
Fibrous hydrophilic nanocarbon (HNC) materials were synthesized via the catalytic reaction of a gas mixture of carbon monoxide (CO) and hydrogen (H2), i.e., syngas, demonstration enhanced performance in water purification.
